title: AST-Grep Structural Pattern Enforcement over Generic Linters
context: Automated architectural boundary and concurrency pattern enforcement in multi-agent repositories.
distilled_learning: Combining ultra-fast syntax scanning (oxlint) with declarative AST-grep rule configurations prevents concurrency bypasses, untyped promise coercions, and package boundary violations in CI.

claims.assertion: Combining ultra-fast syntax scanning (oxlint) with declarative AST-grep rule configurations prevents concurrency bypasses, untyped promise coercions, and package boundary violations in CI.
